note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization uses an eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts. L-BFGS retains only the current last three pairs. There is no physical PDE boundary condition. No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存の31/1023格子観測を再利用します。雑音の標準偏差σは1e-4と1e-3で、独立な基底雑音は2 seedです。尺度・格子文脈をまたぐ比較は同じ雑音ベクトルを共有します。γは固定5点です。 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Reuse existing 31/1023-grid observations. The noise standard deviations sigma are 1e-4 and 1e-3; two seeds provide independent base noises, while scaled/grid-context variants are paired. Gamma has five fixed values. Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.
